description: This PHP class 'FormatWithDateTime' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format DateTime objects into a specific string format in the context of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It is part of the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin' plugin, specifically within the 'AccessStrategy/FormatValue' namespace.

classes.name: FormatWithDateTime
classes.description: A formatter class that converts DateTime objects into a string format 'Y-m-d H:i:s'

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Receives a value and if it is a DateTime instance, returns it formatted as a string 'Y-m-d H:i:s', otherwise returns null.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string 'Y-m-d H:i:s' if given an instance of DateTime; otherwise, returns null.
